tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Slide background. Gallery black is the default; use the paper theme for one or two slides per carousel (quotes, timelines, the 'look again' beat).

tokens.name: ground-raised
tokens.usage: Raised panels on a slide: tag plates behind captions, the phone frame on the CTA, card backs.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Headlines and body copy on ground and ground-raised (gallery 17:1, paper 17:1).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, museum-label metadata and secondary notes on ground (gallery 4.8:1; paper 5:1). The original kit used #8a7f6c on paper too, which is only 3.4:1 — use this paper value for small text.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one emphasised word in a headline (<em>), kickers, bold words in copy, dates in timelines. Gold on gallery black (9:1), oxblood on paper (8:1).

tokens.name: gilt
tokens.usage: Gilt-frame lines, marker rings, loupe borders, leader lines, the active progress dot, filled CTA buttons. Decorative on paper (1.9:1): never use it for paper-slide text.

tokens.name: gilt-dim
tokens.usage: Timeline spine and quiet secondary rules on gallery black.

tokens.name: oxblood
tokens.usage: The rare second accent: the twist, warnings, emphasis on paper slides. At most one use per gallery slide.

tokens.name: on-gilt
tokens.usage: Text and numerals on gilt fills: marker badges, the filled Save/Watch button (9:1).

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Full-width hairlines and the header separator.

styles.name: hero
styles.sample: Its famous name is a mistake.
styles.usage: Cover hook only. 4–8 words, one word in <em> (italic, accent).

styles.name: headline-m
styles.sample: She isn't a guest. She's a logo.
styles.usage: The standard story-slide headline. 9 words max.

styles.name: quote
styles.sample: One of you shall betray me.
styles.usage: Pull quotes. Only real, sourced quotes.

styles.name: label-title
styles.usage: Painting title on the museum label (plate slide).

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: The single giant number on a fact slide, in accent.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: And three of its people are missing.
styles.usage: The one line under the cover hook.

styles.name: copy
styles.sample: Light falls on the captain's open hand, and its shadow lands on his lieutenant's coat.
styles.usage: Story copy. 45 words max per slide.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Secondary notes, legend items, museum label artist line.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Early copy, attributed to Gerrit Lundens
styles.usage: Image captions under frames, in text-muted.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrow above every headline, in accent.

styles.name: chrome
styles.usage: Header and footer on every slide (added automatically by brand.js).

styles.name: tag
styles.usage: Tags on image plates, scraps and split panels.

tokens.name: margin-outer
tokens.usage: Left and right safe margin of every slide. Text never enters it.

tokens.name: safe-top
tokens.usage: Header zone. Nothing but the chrome sits above this line.

tokens.name: safe-bottom
tokens.usage: Footer zone. Nothing but the chrome sits below this line.

tokens.name: gap-s
tokens.usage: Gap between strip panels and scraps.

tokens.name: gap-m
tokens.usage: Gap between split images; headline to copy.

tokens.name: gap-l
tokens.usage: Gap between timeline items and major blocks.

tokens.name: rule-gap
tokens.usage: Space above and below the short gilt rule on the cover.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Frames, image plates, strips, buttons. The brand is square-cornered like a gallery frame.

tokens.name: radius-tag
tokens.usage: Square marker variant and the active progress pill.

tokens.name: radius-phone
tokens.usage: The phone frame on the CTA slide only.

tokens.name: radius-disc
tokens.usage: Marker rings, loupes, numbered badges.

tokens.name: shadow-frame
tokens.usage: Under the gilt-framed painting on the plate slide.

tokens.name: shadow-scrap
tokens.usage: Under paper scraps and polaroid-style inserts.

tokens.name: shadow-loupe
tokens.usage: Under the circular loupe.

tokens.name: canvas-width
tokens.usage: Instagram 4:5 carousel width. Every slide is rendered at exactly 1080 × 1350.

tokens.name: canvas-height
tokens.usage: Instagram 4:5 carousel height.

tokens.name: grain-opacity
tokens.usage: Film-grain overlay on gallery slides (0.22 multiply on paper). Added automatically.

tokens.name: vignette-strength
tokens.usage: Black at the vignette's outer edge on gallery slides.
